trajectory_summary: The call moves fast through verify and lands a booked time, but energy leaks at the close: the customer doesn't know what the appointment is for and has to ask the company name after already agreeing to it. The electric car disclosure at 03:40 is the one real upside the rep captures, but only after being forced to re-explain the appointment.

observed_outcome.quote: K. Cool. Yeah. We'll plan on 4PM tomorrow.
observed_outcome.reasoning: A specific day (tomorrow) and time (4PM) were mutually agreed and confirmed in the button-up. Co-owner (mom) was identified at 01:06 but never discussed for inclusion on the appointment, so co_owner_confirmed is null-leaning-false; marking null since it wasn't explicitly addressed either way and title co-owner does not necessarily equal decision-maker here (customer's mom, not spouse).
observed_outcome.set_rule: booked by time, tentative by rule: bill not_asked

bill_anchor_audit.reasoning: No dollar amount or kWh figure was captured on the call; therefore no flip could be executed.

bill_document_audit.reasoning: The rep never requested a utility bill, photo, or sending method during the call.

interest_reason_audit.use_quote: Yeah. It would. The whole the goal is to offset your utility bill plus the electric car
interest_reason_audit.reasoning: Rep directly ties the customer's stated reason (EV) to the value of the appointment/system and confirms he'll pass it to the specialist.

script_coverage.customer_quote: Hi, Carter. My name is Varun. I actually got a call from me.

script_coverage.quote: Did you put in a request to get some solar information on your home?
Is there anyone else on the title of the home with you?
And then you know how the roof is?
Cool. And then is your credit score above 670?
Did you get solar on your previous home or just look into it?
K. Cool. Yeah. We'll plan on 4PM tomorrow.

primary_coaching_focus.topic: Missing company name at intro caused mid-call trust gap
primary_coaching_focus.why: Customer had to ask 'what's the name of the company' after already agreeing to an appointment -- a legitimacy gap that surfaced live and could have derailed the booking.

key_moments.stewart_read: No company name or lead-source reference in the opening line -- legitimacy is never anchored up front.

key_moments.quote: Some events, were, related to that home, so we cannot proceed with that.
key_moments.stewart_read: Customer flags a specific prior-home solar issue that blocked proceeding, and the rep doesn't ask what it was.

key_moments.quote: So what I'm looking forward to?
key_moments.stewart_read: Customer agreed to a time but genuinely didn't understand what the appointment covers, meaning the button-up handshake didn't functionally land even though all 4 parts were logged.
Strong qualifying signal (EV ownership increases usage and appointment value) volunteered unprompted.
